title: SignBridge Comprehensive ASL Reference Library Catalog

signs.name: A
signs.description: Fist with thumb resting along the side of the index finger, palm facing forward.
signs.notes: Keep the thumb upright against index finger side; do not tuck inside palm.

signs.name: B
signs.description: Flat hand with four fingers straight up and pressed together, thumb folded across palm.
signs.notes: Fingers remain vertical and parallel, palm facing outward.

signs.name: C
signs.description: Curved hand forming a 'C' shape with fingers and thumb, palm facing sideways.
signs.notes: Ensure fingers curve smoothly like gripping a cup.

signs.name: D
signs.description: Index finger straight up, other three fingers touching thumb tip to form an 'O'.
signs.notes: Only the index finger is extended vertically.

signs.name: E
signs.description: All fingers bent down with fingertips resting along the top edge of the folded thumb.
signs.notes: Fingertips curl tightly against the thumb top.

signs.name: F
signs.description: Index finger and thumb touching tips to form a circle; middle, ring, pinky upright.
signs.notes: Resembles an 'OK' sign; keep the other three fingers spread.

signs.name: G
signs.description: Index finger and thumb extended parallel pointing horizontally sideways.
signs.notes: Fingers point across the chest in horizontal parallel lines.

signs.name: H
signs.description: Index and middle fingers extended together horizontally pointing sideways.
signs.notes: Both fingers stay tightly closed together pointing across body.

signs.name: I
signs.description: Pinky finger extended upright, other fingers folded into a fist with thumb across.
signs.notes: Only the little finger is vertical; palm faces forward.

signs.name: J
signs.description: Pinky extended (as in I), swooping downward and curling back up in a 'J' curve in the air.
signs.notes: Dynamic motion sign: trace letter J with the pinky tip.

signs.name: K
signs.description: Index finger pointing up, middle finger angled forward, thumb resting at middle joint.
signs.notes: Index and middle spread in a V; thumb rests between them.

signs.name: L
signs.description: Index finger pointing straight up and thumb extended outward at 90 degrees.
signs.notes: Clear L shape formed between thumb and index finger.

signs.name: M
signs.description: Three fingers folded over the thumb, with thumb tip peeking between ring and pinky.
signs.notes: Three fingers drape over the tucked thumb.

signs.name: N
signs.description: Two fingers (index and middle) folded over thumb, thumb peeking between middle and ring.
signs.notes: Two fingers drape over the tucked thumb.

signs.name: O
signs.description: All fingers and thumb curved with tips meeting to form an 'O' circle.
signs.notes: Smooth rounded circular shape with palm facing forward.

signs.name: P
signs.description: K handshape oriented downward, middle finger pointing toward ground.
signs.notes: Tilt the K sign 90 degrees down from the wrist.

signs.name: Q
signs.description: G handshape oriented downward, index finger and thumb pointing toward ground.
signs.notes: Tilt the G sign downward pointing at the floor.

signs.name: R
signs.description: Index and middle fingers crossed, middle finger behind index, palm facing forward.
signs.notes: Cross fingers tightly like wishing for good fortune.

signs.name: S
signs.description: Fist with thumb wrapped across the front of the curled fingers.
signs.notes: Distinct from A: thumb lies horizontally OVER front fingers.

signs.name: T
signs.description: Fist with thumb inserted between the index and middle fingers.
signs.notes: Thumb peeks up between index and middle knuckles.

signs.name: U
signs.description: Index and middle fingers extended straight up and pressed together, thumb across palm.
signs.notes: Keep both extended fingers touching; palm faces forward.

signs.name: V
signs.description: Index and middle fingers extended straight up and spread apart in a 'V' shape.
signs.notes: Victory / Peace sign handshape.

signs.name: W
signs.description: Index, middle, and ring fingers extended straight up and spread apart in a 'W'.
signs.notes: Three middle fingers spread vertically.

signs.name: X
signs.description: Fist with index finger curled into a hooked shape.
signs.notes: Hooked index finger like a pirate hook; palm sideways.

signs.name: Y
signs.description: Thumb and pinky extended outward, middle three fingers folded into palm.
signs.notes: Iconic shaka / hang-loose handshape.

signs.name: Z
signs.description: Index finger extended, drawing a 'Z' path through the air.
signs.notes: Dynamic motion sign: trace Z in the air with index fingertip.

signs.description: All fingertips touching thumb tip forming a closed oval/zero shape.
signs.notes: Similar to letter O; palm faces forward.

signs.description: Index finger straight up, other fingers curled into fist with thumb across.
signs.notes: Standard number 1 counting sign in ASL.

signs.description: Index and middle fingers straight up and spread into a V.
signs.notes: Similar to letter V; palm faces forward.

signs.description: Thumb, index, and middle fingers extended upright and spread; ring and pinky folded.
signs.notes: Note: ASL 3 uses thumb, not ring finger.

signs.description: Four fingers extended upright and spread; thumb folded across palm.
signs.notes: Palm faces forward with four vertical fingers.

signs.description: All five fingers extended upright and spread apart, palm facing forward.
signs.notes: Open 5 handshape with all digits spread.

signs.description: Thumb and pinky finger touching tips; index, middle, and ring fingers extended upright.
signs.notes: In ASL counting, 6 connects thumb and pinky.

signs.description: Thumb and ring finger touching tips; index, middle, and pinky fingers extended upright.
signs.notes: Connect thumb and ring finger tip.

signs.description: Thumb and middle finger touching tips; index, ring, and pinky fingers extended upright.
signs.notes: Connect thumb and middle finger tip.

signs.description: Thumb and index finger touching tips; middle, ring, and pinky fingers extended upright.
signs.notes: Similar to letter F / OK sign.

signs.name: Hello
signs.description: Open flat B hand at temple, moving outward and slightly upward in a salute gesture.
signs.notes: Universal ASL greeting, 1-hand dominant gesture.

signs.name: Thank You
signs.description: Flat hand touches chin with fingertips and moves outward toward listener.
signs.notes: Expresses gratitude; always directed outward.

signs.name: Bye / Goodbye
signs.description: Open dominant hand (5-hand/flat hand) raised up in front of the shoulder at shoulder/head height, palm facing outward. Fingers wave gently back and forth in a waving motion.
signs.notes: Educational reference: AISA School (https://www.aisa.solutions/asl/signs/bye) and Lifeprint ASL University. Standard ASL Bye is signed at shoulder/head level with open palm facing outward. Verified demonstration video sourced from American Sign Language Dataset under MIT License.

signs.name: Good Morning
signs.description: Compound sign: Good (chin to open palm) followed by Morning (dominant hand rises under non-dominant arm).
signs.notes: Compound sign: GOOD + MORNING.

signs.name: Good Night
signs.description: Compound sign: Good followed by Night (dominant curved hand arches over horizontal non-dominant wrist).
signs.notes: Compound sign: GOOD + NIGHT.

signs.name: Nice to Meet You
signs.description: Flat dominant hand slides across non-dominant palm (Nice), then index fingers meet (Meet).
signs.notes: Compound sign: NICE + MEET + YOU.

signs.name: Welcome
signs.description: Open flat palm facing upward, sweeping inward toward torso from the side.
signs.notes: Gentle inviting scoop toward oneself.

signs.name: How Are You?
signs.description: Both hands in curved-horns shape placed against chest rotating outward (How), then pointing to listener (You).
signs.notes: Common question: HOW + YOU with questioning facial expression.

signs.name: Hello
signs.description: Open flat B hand at temple, moving outward in a salute gesture.
signs.notes: Standard friendly greeting.

signs.name: Help
signs.description: Closed A-fist with thumb upright rests on open flat non-dominant palm, both lifted upward together.
signs.notes: Two-handed sign; can be directional toward recipient.

signs.name: Yes
signs.description: S-fist held upright, tilting up and down at the wrist like a nodding head.
signs.notes: Mimics the vertical nodding motion of agreement.

signs.name: No
signs.description: Index and middle fingers together snap shut against the thumb, palm facing listener.
signs.notes: Sharp, decisive closing motion.

signs.name: Stop
signs.description: Open flat dominant hand chops downward decisively onto open flat non-dominant palm.
signs.notes: Two-handed sign; vertical palm strikes horizontal palm.

signs.name: Thank You
signs.description: Flat hand touches chin with fingertips and extends outward toward listener.
signs.notes: Expresses gratitude; always faces the other person.

signs.name: Please
signs.description: Open flat dominant hand rubs in a clockwise circular motion over the chest/heart.
signs.notes: Polite request sign; circular motion on upper torso. Verified video demonstration.

signs.name: Sorry
signs.description: A-fist rubs in small circular clockwise motion over the heart/chest.
signs.notes: Contrition gesture; resembles Please but made with a closed fist. Verified video demonstration.

signs.name: Water
signs.description: W-handshape (three fingers up) index finger taps twice against the side of the chin or lips.
signs.notes: Letter W taps chin twice. Verified video demonstration.

signs.name: Food
signs.description: Flattened O handshape with fingertips touching, tapped twice against the mouth.
signs.notes: Represents bringing food to the mouth; noun form. Verified video demonstration.

signs.name: Eat
signs.description: Flattened O handshape brought once decisively to the mouth.
signs.notes: Verb form of food; single deliberate motion to mouth. Shares video with Food.

signs.name: Drink
signs.description: C-handshape held like a cup, tilted back toward the mouth as if drinking.
signs.notes: Mimetic cup gesture tipped toward mouth.

signs.name: More
signs.description: Both hands in flattened O handshapes, fingertips tapping together repeatedly in front of chest.
signs.notes: Two-handed sign bringing fingertips together in center. Verified video demonstration.

signs.name: Like
signs.description: Open 8 hand on chest, pulling outward while thumb and middle pinch together.
signs.notes: Pulling a feeling out from the chest. Verified video demonstration.

signs.name: Love
signs.description: Both arms crossed over chest with hands in fists against shoulders, hugging oneself.
signs.notes: Cross arms over heart in a gentle embrace.

signs.name: Want
signs.description: Both open hands palms up with curved claw fingers, pulling back toward body.
signs.notes: Two-handed pulling motion with clawed fingers.

signs.name: Need
signs.description: X-handshape bent downward repeatedly at the wrist in front of body.
signs.notes: Downward flex of hooked index finger; also means Must.

signs.name: Home
signs.description: Flattened O handshape touches the side of the chin, then moves to touch the upper cheek.
signs.notes: Touches where you eat and where you sleep.

signs.name: School
signs.description: Open flat dominant hand claps down twice horizontally onto open flat non-dominant palm.
signs.notes: Two horizontal claps of flat palms.

signs.name: Family
signs.description: Both hands in F-handshape starting with index/thumbs touching, curving outward in a circle until pinkies meet.
signs.notes: Circle represents the family unit boundary.

signs.name: Friend
signs.description: Both index fingers hooked (X-handshapes), interlocked first one way then reversed.
signs.notes: Fingers link together like a chain bond.

signs.name: Mother
signs.description: Open 5-handshape with thumb touching the chin, fingers spread upright.
signs.notes: Lower face represents feminine signs in ASL.

signs.name: Father
signs.description: Open 5-handshape with thumb touching the forehead, fingers spread upright.
signs.notes: Upper face represents masculine signs in ASL.

signs.name: Work
signs.description: Both hands in S-fists; dominant wrist taps twice on top of non-dominant wrist.
signs.notes: Tapping fists symbolize manual labor.

signs.name: Time
signs.description: Dominant index finger taps twice on the back of the non-dominant wrist where a watch is worn.
signs.notes: Mimics checking a wristwatch.

signs.name: Day
signs.description: Non-dominant arm held horizontally; dominant index finger upright resting on elbow, sweeping down like the sun setting.
signs.notes: Arc of the sun across the sky.

signs.name: Night
signs.description: Non-dominant arm horizontal; dominant curved hand drapes over the horizontal non-dominant wrist.
signs.notes: The sun dropping below the horizon.

signs.name: Man
signs.description: Thumb of open 5-hand touches forehead, then hand moves down to touch chest.
signs.notes: Combines Father location with flat chest touch.

signs.name: Woman
signs.description: Thumb of open 5-hand touches chin, then moves down to touch chest.
signs.notes: Combines Mother location with flat chest touch.

signs.name: Boy
signs.description: Dominant hand at forehead grabs and opens like grasping the brim of a baseball cap twice.
signs.notes: Action resembles grabbing a cap visor.

signs.name: Girl
signs.description: Dominant A-hand thumb strokes downward along the jawline from ear to chin.
signs.notes: Mimics the bonnet string of historic dresses.

signs.name: Name
signs.description: Both hands in H-handshape; dominant index/middle cross over non-dominant index/middle tapping twice.
signs.notes: Fingers form an X-tap pattern.

signs.name: Understand
signs.description: Dominant index finger flicks upward like a lightbulb turning on near the temple/forehead.
signs.notes: Flicking finger mimics an idea popping up.

signs.name: How are you?
signs.description: Two curved hands against chest roll outward (How), followed by index pointing forward (You).
signs.notes: Facial grammar: furrow brows for Wh-questions.

signs.name: I love you
signs.description: Hand with thumb, index, and pinky extended upright while middle and ring are folded (ILY handshape).
signs.notes: Iconic ASL sign combining I, L, and Y letters.

signs.name: See you later
signs.description: V-handshape points to eyes then flicks forward (See), points to listener (You), then L-hand tilts forward (Later).
signs.notes: Casual American sign phrase.

signs.name: Thank you very much
signs.description: Two-handed Thank You: both open hands touch chin and sweep forward extensively with a slight bow.
signs.notes: Deep expression of appreciation.

signs.name: What is your name?
signs.description: Point to person (You), sign Name (crossed H-fingers), then open 5-hands palms up shaking slightly (What).
signs.notes: Word order in ASL: YOU NAME WHAT? with furrowed brows.

signs.name: Need help
signs.description: Sign Need (X-hook flexes down) followed immediately by Help (fist on flat palm lifted).
signs.notes: Essential emergency communication phrase.

signs.name: You are welcome
signs.description: Open flat palm held in front sweeps inward toward signer in a gracious arc.
signs.notes: Polite response to Thank You.

signs.name: Nice to meet you
signs.description: Flat palm slides across flat base (Nice), then index fingers touch (Meet), point forward (You).
signs.notes: Standard cordial greeting phrase.

signs.name: Have a good day
signs.description: Compound: Good (chin to palm) followed by Day (arm arching down).
signs.notes: Friendly parting wish.
